observations: Photo 0: Front view of a smartphone with a severely cracked screen, showing multiple long cracks and spiderwebbing. The phone is lying on a white box, on a dark green tiled surface. A SIM ejector tool is visible in the top left corner.

Photo 1: Back view of the same phone, showing a triple-camera setup with circular lenses, a flash, and a label with 'TECNO CM6 256+8 GB A' and other details. The back panel is grey with a curved design. The phone is resting on the same white box.
Photo 2: Another front view, similar to photo 0, showing the same cracked screen. The phone is still on the white box, with a blue bottle cap visible in the bottom right corner.
All photos have a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI MON AMI'.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 2 show a severely cracked screen, which contradicts 'good condition'.
No photo shows the side of the phone where volume buttons are located. The side is not visible in any photo.

risks.risk: Screen damage may affect touch functionality or require replacement
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the screen showing touch responsiveness or a video of the screen being used.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional or requiring screen replacement

risks.risk: Volume buttons are broken as claimed, which affects usability
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the side of the phone with the volume buttons, and a demonstration of their operation or lack thereof.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if volume buttons are non-functional

risks.risk: Internal damage from screen cracks may affect other components
risks.proof: A video showing the phone powered on, with all functions working, or a diagnostic report.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially having internal damage

proof_requests: Photo of the side of the phone showing the volume buttons and their condition.
Video of the phone being turned on and used, showing screen touch responsiveness and all functions working.
Close-up of the screen damage to assess if it affects touch functionality.
response.reason: The phone's identity is confirmed as TECNO CM6, but the screen is severely cracked, contradicting the 'good condition' claim. The volume button issue is unverified as no side view is shown. Hidden risks include screen functionality and internal damage. Proof is needed to assess usability and price accurately.
